status: Blue/cyan layout candidate; awaiting feedback, not installed.
prompt:
Refine attached reference1 into ONE complete, harmonious Chinese dungeon planning UI with a deliberately designed BLUE + CYAN Cold Steel palette, better spatial proportions, and coherent graphic motifs. User explicitly requests introducing blue/cyan and reasonable layout/pattern adjustments. Reference1 is the previous concept to edit; reference2 is an existing game's accepted Cold Steel material/icon reference, ONLY for geometric steel craftsmanship and blue/cyan luminosity, not for placing portals everywhere.

Output 1672x941 landscape, one high-fidelity full-screen game UI concept. No collage, comparison board, device/browser chrome or version labels.

LOCK THE PRODUCT SCOPE:
Upper cinematic gothic castle scene with moon, candles/skull left, raven right; all route, reward, invasion and action components remain INSIDE ONE LOWER planning console. Keep the chosen left route / right dossier model, five reward categories, intrusion status, safe evacuation and forced abandonment. No new systems, menus, portraits or invented stats. Improve the layout as specified below; do not merely apply a blue filter to reference1.

COLOR SYSTEM, intentional and harmonious:
Approximate visual mass 65% deep desaturated navy-charcoal, 25% slate/steel blue surfaces, 10% restrained cyan highlights and silver details. Real base palette #090c0f, #101419, #171d23, #232b33 remains the grounding; USER-REQUESTED new concept accents: midnight navy #101e2d, steel blue #1c354b, muted blue #345f7d, fog blue #94c4e4, soft clear cyan #8fd2dc, slightly stronger cyan #69c9d6. These must be visibly present, more intentional than the nearly grayscale reference.
- Outer shell: charcoal/navy brushed metal.
- Main route bed: quiet matte midnight blue with a subtle broad diffuse gradient, no dead pure-black slab.
- Dossier and info bands: slightly lighter steel blue, softly distinguished without many nested boxes.
- Cyan: short selected-route path, selected-node outline, small section accent strokes, main action edge/arrow. Not every line, label and icon glowing.
- Body text remains off-white #eef3f5, muted text #9ca8b1. Do not color all text cyan.
- Risk values and loss warning stay muted warm red/coral. This is the only conspicuous warm UI accent. Safe availability can retain a tiny muted green status dot; no solid green button.
- Keep the original warm candle light upstairs to balance the moonlit blue scenery, do not recolor flames cyan.
NO saturated royal blue, purple, rainbow route colors, gigantic bloom, lens flare, holographic neon board, bright white panels or green/blue mismatch. Blue is structural depth, cyan is attention/state.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Follow actual project's clean Microsoft YaHei UI-style Chinese sans-serif, Consolas-style tabular numbers. Disciplined 20/16/14/12px nominal hierarchy, title weight700, subheading600, ordinary labels/body400-500. Sharp legibility, comfortably spaced. No Song/Ming serifs, brush type, extruded lettering, wide tracking, oversized button labels. Do not assume giant text conveys hierarchy. Make all warning text readable. 4 sizes maximum, scale consistently for the canvas.

NEW PROPORTIONS AND LAYOUT:
Upper scenery about27% of height (y0 to~250), retain readable castle/moon composition. Lower unified planning console fills y250..930 with safe outer margins. A clear blue-gray horizontal separation integrates scenery with console. Do not shrink scenery to a tiny strip.

A. CONSOLE TOP RAIL y~255..322:
Left title "探索规划", secondary "恐怖地牢 · D级"; middle "探索进度 0 / 45" with small thin progress ticks. Right, compact "时空特工入侵", "0%", "尚未开始判定" and a slim blue-gray empty meter. All aligned on coherent baselines. No big empty oversized threat bar. Optional tiny simple caution glyph, never a hooded figurine. Title may have one short cyan underline or index tick, no medallion.

B. MAIN EXPLORATION AREA y~325..660:
Left about72% width is the map. Right about28% is selected-node dossier, set apart by subtle steel-blue surface tint and a fine short divider, not a huge frame.
- Map: four ordered branch lanes, with gentle x/y staggering and adequate node/label spacing. Roughly12-15 nodes, restrained smooth elbows/curves, NO X crossings or spaghetti. Current start at left with "当前位置", selected adjacent elite target above-right with "可前往". ONLY the direct edge from current to that immediately reachable selected target is cyan and clear. Other immediate reachable branches are subdued mist-blue solid, future branches dim blue-gray dashed. Cyan ends before unvisited future chain; don't imply node skipping. All silhouettes high enough contrast to recognize.
- Nodes: precise thin hexagonal/chamfered cold-steel frames, quiet blue-gray faces. Clean shallow-faceted silver glyphs (gate, straight crossed blades, minimal angular horn-mask, lockbox, question mark), consistent48px-ish size. The selected icon has a small cyan reflection, not an electric-blue orb. No circular antique coins, realistic skull sculptures, unnecessary miniature ornament. State is also conveyed by outline, dash and label, not color alone.
- Compact text/navigation controls "路线总览" and "当前位置" at map top-right, quiet blue-gray thin controls.
- Dossier: "节点档案", same exact compact elite glyph as selected node, "精英遭遇", secondary "可前往"; concise aligned rows "风险" / "较高" (warm red) and "收益" / "较高" (white); helper "准备充分后再前往". Do NOT place a giant button in this column anymore: the main action is in footer at far right. Dossier must remain focused and not gain fictional fields.

C. FULL-WIDTH REWARD BAND y~670..795:
Unlike reference1, stretch expected rewards ACROSS THE ENTIRE PANEL under both map and dossier, giving five real categories sufficient room. This is a single integrated steel-blue horizontal strip, not five floating cards. Small heading "预期收益", secondary "地牢规则预览 · 非已获得". Five open unequal-width groups with fine short separators and aligned text. Use minimal18-24px icons with a cohesive silver/blue material; remove oversized currency medals. Exact content:
"首领金币" / "5,500–6,500"
"通关金币" / "5,000 起"
"竞技场宝箱" / "75% · 1,800金" / "强化石1 / 重铸券1必得"
"精英附加" / "优质装备 · 50%"
"祭品范围" / "普通—传说"
Give the chest category a little extra width for the second line. These are prospective rule-based rewards, NOT acquired loot or guaranteed sum. Don't omit categories.

D. BOTTOM ACTION DOCK y~805..923:
Keep ALL operations within the same console, with deliberate separation:
Left group: small contextual label "撤离管理", modest gray-blue secondary button "安全撤离", readable helper "仅起点可用 · 保留战利品". Current frame shows start, so enabled appearance is coherent.
Middle group, separated by whitespace and thin rule: understated "强制放弃" button with warm-red text/outline, explicit nearby or below warning "丢失背包全部物品", smaller "需二次确认". No skull decoration, no solid bright red fill. This remains an exceptional destructive action.
Far right, aligned under dossier: main button "进入节点" with small right arrow, clearly dominant via richer STEEL BLUE fill, fine CYAN rim and crisp white label, not giant size. Enough space separates it from abandonment to avoid confusion. No duplicated entering button in dossier.
Each group has comfortable aligned padding. Header/footer borders restrained, no heavy doubled cages.

GRAPHIC MOTIF PLAN:
Use ONE coherent geometric language echoing thin hexagonal node frames: short angled corner cuts, fine diagonal notches, rare hexagonal facet etching. Put the faint pattern ONLY in console corners/empty margin areas, max about3-5% contrast. Keep route paths and text backgrounds CLEAN; don't draw false route lines, decorative grids or circuit bundles behind them. Add a very subtle blue wash behind map current position and slight cyan edge accents on selected interactive elements. This is controlled material design, not a sci-fi circuit poster. No flower scrolls, rivets, grunge, chains, embossed lettering or repeated skull patterns.

The overall result must visibly improve harmony and usability: night-blue surfaces connect visually to the moonlit scenery, cyan gives one clear reading path, steel remains tactile but restrained, right dossier is compact, reward text has room, and footer clearly separates continuing exploration from safe/dangerous exit. All Chinese text sharp and accurate.
